dataset: DEEP-10M, d=96, official 2k queries unless noted
objective: replace the point-level best-first loose-recall walk with a GenBO-style routed, tiered, graph-free path

reference.method: portal-SQ4 entries plus graph-local adaptive walk, L=88

alternatives.name: global portal fan-out streaming
alternatives.reason: 6,440 streamed SQ4 assignments and 144 short bucket streams cost more than roughly 1,600 query-directed walk evaluations

alternatives.name: fixed support-witness tiles
alternatives.reason: even SQ4-compressed 8-witness headers cost over twice the scan bytes they save, before their second ranking pass

alternatives.name: co-retrieval tile diffusion
alternatives.reason: cell transitions dilute query direction and bucket transitions are too sparse at the available training-query density

alternatives.name: portal-local residual product enumeration
alternatives.reason: the independently trained half-space product code is not aligned with the fine-cell residual geometry

alternatives.name: portal-local WAND sphere bounds
alternatives.reason: even exact per-bucket radii produce vacuous high-dimensional bounds and preferentially select large, expensive buckets

alternatives.name: learned maximum-relevance tile routing

results.method: 90% portal score plus 10% learned score and occupancy penalty

alternatives.reason: the small containment gain comes mainly from occupancy bias; it does not reach the actual-retrieval target with fewer bytes and adds 2,048 tree predictions per query

alternatives.name: sparse residual-code voting

results.configuration: 32 routed cells, four codes per half, require both votes

alternatives.reason: independent subspace collisions are too weak at the candidate budget

alternatives.name: cell-major batched portal streaming
alternatives.reason: page reuse is canceled by request sorting and materializing roughly 13M scored assignment tuples

verdict: The graph-free candidates validate GenBO's coverage model but do not replace the loose-recall walk. The walk remains the default because its query-directed work reduction is larger than the locality advantage of block streaming.
